bibliographic_discovery_candidates_not_c.citation: A. N. Kolmogorov, Three Approaches to the Definition of the Concept 'Quantity of Information', Problemy Peredachi Informatsii 1(1) (1965), 3-11
bibliographic_discovery_candidates_not_c.candidate_locator: Section 3, printed pages 8-10, especially the displayed Main Theorem and proof
bibliographic_discovery_candidates_not_c.candidate_summary: Defines conditional shortest-program complexity for partial recursive description methods, proves existence of an asymptotically optimal method using a universal partial recursive function, and derives bounded additive invariance between optimal methods.
bibliographic_discovery_candidates_not_c.status: Russian primary scan inspected for source-family and candidate-root discrimination only; the catalog does not cite or select it, and no accepted translation comparison, complete definition and premise mapping, correction/errata audit, or independent H0 review is credited
